description: 63 rebased onto 64: in client reference manifests, a chunk group's client chunk list (each JavaScript chunk's URL and, for a merged chunk, its component chunks' paths and sizes) and a layout segment's SSR chunk paths are turbo-tasks functions, computed once and shared by every client reference of the segment and every page under the same layouts, instead of rebuilt per client reference per page; a page adds each chunk group's assets to its references once. Same manifests, same order
